markets.rules_secondary:
Only the European Commission's announcement that it has adopted the delegated act counts, whether by press release, by an official posting such as in the Register of Delegated Acts, or by publication in the Official Journal of the European Union; the act need not have entered into force. The act counts whether the Annex lists Executive Order 14203 itself or regulations or other instruments implementing U.S. sanctions on the International Criminal Court.

The following do NOT count:
A proposal, draft, consultation or announced intention, or a statement that the blocking statute remains an option
Other measures to protect the International Criminal Court, such as funding, guidance or a Council decision
A delegated act that adds only U.S. measures unrelated to the International Criminal Court

A new version of an existing Emergency Directive, such as V1 of ED 26-03
A supplemental direction to an existing Emergency Directive
A Binding Operational Directive
An addition to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, and any remediation deadline that follows from one
A CISA alert, advisory or other guidance urging agencies or the public to act
A statement that an Emergency Directive is under consideration or forthcoming

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if Bitcoin crosses the specified price threshold.
markets.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $130000 starting Sep 22, 2026 and before Oct 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.

markets.rules_primary: If a snap general election to the Legislative Assembly of Alberta is called after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

A snap election is a general election to the Legislative Assembly of Alberta with a polling day earlier than the fixed election day of October 18, 2027 under section 38.1 of the Election Act. A qualifying call is an announcement by the Premier or the Lieutenant Governor, or an order of the Lieutenant Governor in Council authorizing the issue of writs, that specifies an actual polling day. Calls for an election, speculation, a leadership review, or a loss of confidence without such a call do not qualify. The general election on the fixed date and by-elections do not qualify.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the President signs a proclamation or executive order, or the Department of Commerce or U.S. Customs and Border Protection publishes a Federal Register notice, that reduces the generally applicable ad valorem Section 232 duty rate on aluminum articles (as defined in Proclamation 9704, as amended) that are products of Canada below 50% after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from the White House or the Federal Register qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The market resolves on signing or publication of the qualifying instrument, not on its effective date.

Counts as Yes:
A flat rate cut on all or any defined subset of covered Canadian aluminum articles, including reinstatement of the August 2026 framework at 25%
A tariff-rate quota under which in-quota Canadian aluminum enters below 50%
A country exemption or North American metals arrangement that lowers or removes the duty on Canadian aluminum

Does NOT count:
The July 20, 2026 primary-aluminum onshoring incentive (approved firms importing at half the rate) or any expansion of it
Commerce's investment-commitment program allowing individual Canadian or Mexican producers to apply for a 25% rate
Individual importer exclusions under the Commerce exclusion process
Changes to derivative aluminum products only, with the base article rate unchanged
Changes to US-content deductions or smelt-and-cast rules that leave the headline rate at 50%
Court rulings enjoining or vacating the tariff
Framework agreements, announcements, or press statements without a signed legal instrument
markets.title: Will the US cut the 50% aluminum tariff on Canada before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. share of global GDP for 2026 is above 25.1%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the United States’ percentage share of World gross domestic product in current U.S. dollars for 2026, calculated using the World Bank’s World Development Indicators.

The Expiration Value will be calculated as: 100 × United States GDP ÷ World GDP

“United States GDP” and “World GDP” refer to the values attributed to 2026 for the World Bank indicator “GDP (current US$),” series code NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, for the economies United States and World, respectively.

Both inputs must be taken from the first World Development Indicators database release in which values attributed to 2026 are available for both the United States and World.
markets.title: Will U.S. share of global GDP for 2026 be above 25.1%?

markets.rules_primary: If legislation providing new funding for air traffic control modernization has become law after Issuance and before Dec 12, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A qualifying law is legislation that appropriates new funds, or otherwise makes new funds available, for air traffic control modernization, such as air traffic control systems, telecommunications, facilities or towers, in addition to the regular annual appropriations for the Federal Aviation Administration. The Modern Skies Act, an emergency or supplemental appropriations act, or a successor bill qualifies if its enacted text provides such funds. It may be any vehicle, including a larger package such as a continuing resolution, omnibus or reconciliation law, whose text as enacted contains a qualifying provision.

The following do NOT count:
Regular annual appropriations for the Federal Aviation Administration, at any level, unless the law designates the amount as an emergency requirement
Continuing appropriations at the existing rate
Legislation that only authorizes future appropriations, or only funds airports or terminals without funding air traffic control
A transfer or reprogramming of funds already available to the Federal Aviation Administration
Passage by one chamber, or a bill that has not become law
markets.title: Will legislation providing new funding for air traffic control modernization become law before Dec 12, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Mark Hunt leaves (or announces he will leave) as West Virginia State Auditor before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

markets.rules_primary: If California announces it is lifting its Nov 11, 2026 ban on Waymo's driverless freeway service after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency after Issuance and before the market's deadline.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states California announced it is lifting, or has lifted, its Nov 11, 2026 ban on Waymo's driverless freeway service, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

An official announcement by the California DMV or another California state authority that it is lifting the ban counts when it is made, even if the lift takes effect later. Lifting the ban outright also counts. Waymo does not need to resume freeway rides.

The following do NOT count:
Statements that California is reviewing or considering lifting the ban
Permission limited to testing or an individual route
Waymo resuming freeway rides outside California

markets.rules_primary: If a repeal by Governor Gina Hinojosa or her administration of the general age-21 requirement for retail sales of consumable hemp products containing hemp-derived THC is enacted in Texas before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this Contract, Texas's under-21 hemp sales ban refers to the general age-21 requirement in 25 TAC §§300.701 and 300.702 and 16 TAC §§35.5 and 35.6 for retail sales of consumable hemp products containing hemp-derived THC. A repeal counts only if it lowers the general minimum age to 18 or below, or removes it, under both sets of rules. The repeal may be implemented in one or more measures, including final agency rules adopted by Hinojosa's administration, an executive order she issues, or legislation she signs or that becomes law without her signature. Measures adopted before she takes office do NOT count. Rescinding Executive Order GA-56 alone, changes limited to enforcement, and exceptions for particular products or sellers do NOT count.

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness
Administrative regulations: completion of required rulemaking procedures (notice, comment periods, etc.) and final publication in the official government record

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces departure or actually leaves office.
markets.rules_primary:
If Benjamin Netanyahu
 has either officially announced their intention to leave all political office in Israel or has actually left all political office in Israel before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

"All political office in Israel" means every one of the following: Benjamin Netanyahu's seat in the Knesset, the office of Prime Minister and any other ministerial post, and the leadership of the Likud party. An announcement or departure covering only some of these does NOT count. An announcement that he will leave more than a year after the announcement, such as at the end of a rotation or unity-government term, does NOT count. An announcement does NOT count if, in the same announcement, he says he will seek or accept another political office, including the presidency of Israel.
markets.title: Will Benjamin Netanyahu leave all political office in Israel before Jan 1, 2027?

For the purposes of this market, a championship refers to the single, officially recognized top-level championship of the Governing league. A conference championship, division title, or any other mid-season tournament title does not count.

New York (2025-26)
Oklahoma City (2024-25)
Boston (2023-24)
Denver (2022-23)

markets.rules_primary: If Jensen Huang testifies in front of Congress before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Payout criteria
For the purposes of this Contract, "testified" means that Jensen Huang appeared before Congress (in-person, remotely, or virtually), was sworn in or affirmed, or otherwise appeared in an official proceeding where testimony was compelled or authorized by the committee, and provided substantive answers to questions regarding the subject matter of the hearing.
If Jensen Huang provides at least one substantive answer to a question about the hearing's subject matter — even if Jensen Huang invokes the Fifth Amendment or another privilege in response to all other questions — the Contract resolves "Yes."
Depositions conducted under congressional authority.
Testifying in a closed-door or classified session.
If Jensen Huang appears for a transcribed interview, deposition, or hearing that is not conducted under oath but is officially authorized by the committee and conducted under penalty of making false statements to Congress (18 U.S.C. § 1001), such appearance qualifies for purposes of this Contract, provided Jensen Huang provides at least one substantive answer to a substantive question about the hearing's subject matter.

Doesn't count for payout: Statements made outside of an official committee hearing, deposition, or transcribed interview, such as informal staff-level conversations, proffer sessions with executive branch officials, media events on Capitol grounds, personal statements to individual members of Congress, or written correspondence with committee members or staff.

markets.rules_primary: If, after Issuance and before Dec 1, 2026, Flávio Bolsonaro visits Brazil by physically travelling to and being present within its geographic boundaries, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, "Renew" means any of the following, regardless of the specific label used by the parties or the press:
A formal extension, renewal, or amendment of the Existing Agreement's term.
A new or successor agreement between Reddit and Google covering data licensing for AI training, AI search, or related uses of Reddit content, executed to succeed or continue the Existing Agreement's commercial relationship, whether or not its financial terms differ from the Existing Agreement.
Public confirmation (by either party) that the Existing Agreement's licensing relationship is continuing on a going-forward basis past its original term, even absent a newly executed document.

The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

markets.rules_primary: If United States of America v. James Brien Comey, Jr. (No. 1:26-cr-00229, D.D.C.) including any indictment that replaces it charging Comey with the disclosure alleged in that case has been dismissed by the court or administrative body with jurisdiction after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A dismissal is defined as:

For Criminal Cases:
Dismissal of charges by prosecutor (nolle prosequi)
Court-ordered dismissal for constitutional violations
Dismissal for speedy trial violations
Dismissal for prosecutorial misconduct
Dismissal for insufficient evidence
Dismissal following successful motion to dismiss

The following do NOT constitute dismissals:
Settlement agreements between parties
Plea bargains or guilty pleas in criminal cases
Default judgments
Summary judgments on the merits
Trial verdicts (guilty, not guilty, liable, not liable)
Consent decrees or agreed orders
Cases transferred to different courts
Cases stayed or continued indefinitely
Bankruptcy discharge (which is a substantive resolution)
Cases resolved through alternative dispute resolution
Appeals or remands (unless the appellate court dismisses the case entirely)
Temporary restraining orders or preliminary injunctions
Administrative closure

If only some claims, counts, or defendants are dismissed while the case continues on other matters, this does NOT constitute a dismissal for purposes of this contract. The entire case must be dismissed.

Dismissal of the information while an indictment charging Comey with the disclosure alleged in it is pending does NOT constitute a dismissal.

This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency. 

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency, that A) explicitly states the Australian Parliament's passage of the legislation implementing the Australia-European Union Free Trade Agreement occurred, is true, or has been verified, B) based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

The Australian Parliament passes the legislation implementing the agreement when both the House of Representatives and the Senate have passed the bill, or every bill if more than one, that gives effect to the agreement's tariff commitments in Australian law, such as amendments to the Customs Act 1901 and the Customs Tariff Act 1995. Royal Assent is not required.

The following do NOT count:
Signing of the agreement, tabling of the treaty text or National Interest Analysis, or a report of the Joint Standing Committee on Treaties
Passage of a bill by one House only, or a motion or committee referral that does not pass a bill
Approval of the agreement by the European Union, the European Parliament or any EU member state, or the agreement's entry into force
